title: Bastion Reprieve: Pity Edition
description: A few more piglins, less brutes. A compromise between 1.16.1 and modern Minecraft.
body:
Ever since Brutes were added in 1.16.2, they've taken up slots in Bastions, reducing how many tradable piglins there are.

This is the Pity Edition of [Bastion Reprieve](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bastion-reprieve), where instead less piglins spawn and more brutes are kept, resulting in an experience closer to the current game.

If you want an experience closer to 1.16.1 or want bastions to be easier without getting rid of brutes, then I recommend using the original.
